newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Standard in US$40 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Asia Standard in US$40 mln bond issue.

text.p: Asia Standard International Group Ltd said it proposed to issue US$40 million worth of guaranteed convertible bonds due on November 29, 2001.

The bonds, which bear an interest rate of seven percent per annum payable annually, will carry rights to convert into shares of Asia Standard at a conversion price HK$2.31 per share subject to adjustment, the property investment concern said.
Asia Standard said it has granted an option to the manager of the issue to require the company to issue a further US$15 million in bonds, it said.
It said 133.89 million new shares or 8.8 percent of the company's enlarged share capital would be issued on full conversion of the US$40 million bond issue.
A total of 184.09 million shares or 11.7 percent of the enlarged share capital would be issued on full conversion of the US$55 million bond issue, it said.
The bonds are being offered to investors in Asia and to professional investors in Hong Kong. An application has been made to list the bonds in Luxembourg, it said.
Chairman Clement Fung said the net proceeds would be used for property development, land acquisition and working capital.
